cpu_queue_rule: Do not derive per-path CPU or queue time from whole-child GNU Time; collect and report separately instrumented per-path CPU/wait evidence or mark unsupported. Unprofiled elapsed ranking is primary.
frequency_rule: 100 evenly spaced valid warm observations from each of five S01 blocks per version, plus all 100 valid S03 observations from each of five blocks per version; 500 calls per path and version; source/wheel/raw/independent-audit hashes must match
latency_boundary: Installed Python call through materialized result; S01 and S03 use different real database fixtures and their independently frozen setup; session-first and setup excluded
limits: This is a declared workload proxy across separately measured fixtures; it does not establish production frequencies, cross-SDK equivalence, per-path CPU/queue attribution or a full release verdict.
negative_fixtures: S01 and S03 independent auditors reject altered ordered result, block schedule or reopened state; mix analyzer rejects false selected semantics, missing count, nonpositive latency and unequal path counts.
ranking_rule: For each corpus size and version, sum all 500 selected elapsed ns for each of ten equally frequent operation paths, order descending with path-name tie break, and report the smallest prefix reaching at least 80% of total. Keep all valid slow calls.
scope: Reproducible equal-frequency installed-Python query-cost proxy over exact-source S01 and S03 paired materialized calls; one component of broader Phase 1, not production traffic
severe_rare_paths: Keep erasure, failed projection commit, provider failure, malformed row, FFI panic and permission/busy refusal outside frequency-ranked query mix and rank by outcome severity.
